# Payments Requirements Quality Checklist: Stripe Checkout for Paid Courses

**Purpose**: Review whether the money, security and exactly-once requirements are complete, clear and consistent before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command (non-interactive run: depth Standard, audience PR reviewer, focus on money correctness and payment security).
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Money and Price Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the supported currencies, the minimum and the maximum amount stated with exact values rather than adjectives? [Clarity, Spec FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it defined what "free" is, and that a missing price is never treated as free? [Clarity, Spec FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the rule for a price change while a checkout is open, or after an order, stated for both a rise and a fall, and for a change to free? [Coverage, Spec FR-002, US3 scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the list price and the amount charged distinguished everywhere an order's amount is mentioned? [Consistency, Spec FR-007, FR-020]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the handling of taxes, fees and receipts stated as out of scope rather than silent? [Assumption, Spec FR-022, Assumptions]

## Exactly-Once and Idempotence

- [ ] CHK006 Is "exactly once" defined for each thing that must not repeat: the paid transition, the enrolment, the refund and the revocation? [Clarity, Spec FR-010, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK007 Are duplicate, out-of-order, delayed and concurrent deliveries each named as scenarios with an expected outcome? [Coverage, Spec US1 scenario 4, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the outcome defined when two payments for the same student and course both succeed? [Coverage, Spec FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the outcome defined when a payment completes after the course stopped being published? [Coverage, Spec FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the order's allowed status moves listed, including which moves are impossible? [Completeness, Spec FR-007, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated what the provider is told (success or failure) for every kind of message outcome? [Completeness, Spec FR-012]

## Access Control

- [ ] CHK012 Is every path to paid content (enrol, read, files, video, quiz) covered by the unpaid-access rule, not only the enrol action? [Coverage, Spec FR-004, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Is it stated that the browser's return from the payment page grants nothing, and is that testable? [Measurability, Spec FR-008, US2 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the grandfathering rule for students enrolled while the course was free precise enough to check by data alone? [Clarity, Spec FR-014, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the race between a free enrolment and a price being set addressed? [Gap, Spec FR-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Is access after a full refund defined for every place a student sees the course (page, My Learning, announcements, certificates)? [Coverage, Spec FR-015, Assumptions]

## Security and Secrets

- [ ] CHK017 Are the secrets named, with where they may and may not appear, and who may read them? [Completeness, Spec FR-017]
- [ ] CHK018 Is authenticity verification required for every inbound message, and is the rejection behaviour defined? [Completeness, Spec FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the amount the payer is charged defined as coming only from the course, never from the request? [Clarity, Spec FR-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the hardening and isolation requirements for the public endpoint stated without naming a fixed design? [Clarity, Spec FR-021]

## Administrator-Managed Connection (added 2026-11-18)

- [ ] CHK029 Is it defined that the key and signing secret are never readable after saving, by whom, and what the page may show instead? [Clarity, Spec FR-023, SC-009]
- [ ] CHK030 Is a failed or concurrent save defined to leave either the old or the new connection fully working, with no mixed state? [Completeness, Spec FR-025, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Are rotation and switching to a different account distinguished, with the rule for open checkouts and for orders paid under an earlier account stated? [Clarity, Spec FR-026, FR-028]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the behaviour for students, instructors and existing prices defined while nothing is connected or a change is in progress? [Coverage, Spec FR-027]
- [ ] CHK033 Is it stated that only one administrator-only function may write credentials and that every change is recorded without the values? [Completeness, Spec FR-029]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the effect of saving a test-mode key on a stage with real students stated as a visible choice rather than silently allowed? [Risk, Spec Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Does the local-development requirement keep the writing path identical to a deployed stage, with no pre-connected shortcut? [Consistency, Spec FR-030]

## Refunds and Failed Payments

- [ ] CHK021 Is the difference between a full and a partial refund defined, with the effect of each on access and on the order? [Clarity, Spec FR-015, US4]
- [ ] CHK022 Are cancelled, expired and declined payments each defined, with the order and enrolment outcome? [Coverage, Spec FR-016, US5]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the one-hour checkout life stated once and used consistently? [Consistency, Spec FR-006, FR-016]

## Local Development and Operations

- [ ] CHK024 Does the stand-in requirement list the outcomes it must be able to produce (paid, failed, cancelled, expired, refunded, duplicate)? [Completeness, Spec FR-018]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the unmatched-payment case (no order found) given an operator-visible outcome? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the deployed-stage check against the provider's test mode named as a human step rather than assumed? [Gap, Spec FR-018]

## Dependencies and Sibling Issues

- [ ] CHK027 Are the points where coupons (#285) and payouts (#286) extend orders and fulfilment stated, and the work left to them listed? [Dependency, Spec FR-020, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the interactions with certificates, announcements, the catalogue and the dashboard specs stated and non-conflicting? [Consistency, Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
